name: 31407 · Port Wentwrth, GA
findings: ZIP 31407 (Port Wentwrth) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31407 (Port Wentwrth) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 31407 (Port Wentwrth) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 36% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
